invariants.rationale: The method always returns the value from HoodieMergeHandleFactory.create, so null is unlikely unless it allows null creates.
instantTime is used as a parameter when calling HoodieMergeHandleFactory.create, so it should be non-null.
partitionPath is passed directly to HoodieMergeHandleFactory.create and likely must be non-null.
fileId is passed to HoodieMergeHandleFactory.create, which might expect non-null file identifiers.
keyToNewRecords is used as an argument in the factory call, and null maps would likely cause problems downstream.
